title: Copilot Studio: agent node runs an AI agent as a workflow step
summary: The roadmap facts, credit controls and agent-node behaviour are supported. The remaining Work IQ policy question incorrectly leaves a documented governance boundary in doubt: Microsoft describes Work IQ in Copilot Studio as using Work IQ MCP, whose policy applies across the tenant.
